en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large equestrian monument in a European city square. The statue shows a bearded man in military attire and cloak, wearing a spiked helmet, on horseback atop a tall stone pedestal decorated with relief panels and wreaths. Two boys in early‑20th‑century clothing sit on the railing around the monument. In the background are multi‑story townhouses with steep roofs and shop signs in German lining the square.
